correctness.rationale: Equality of fixed-window outputs makes the cumulative-output difference periodic with period h. The identity C(t)=C(0)+S(0)-S(t), together with nonnegative monotone S, forces every cumulative trajectory to converge. A periodic function with a limit is constant, so fixed-window and cumulative outputs induce the same parameter indistinguishability classes up to an irrelevant additive C-shift. The instantaneous-incidence case follows by integration. The source's cumulative structural classification and alternative parameter branch were checked directly in the full paper.

value.rationale: The result closes the exact structural-incidence case that the motivating paper leaves open and prevents a misleading interpretation of its practical ranking. It shows that, for this closed SEIR model, incidence cannot be structurally more informative than cumulative incidence under perfect continuous observation, so the observed practical advantage must be attributed to the measurement and estimation design. This directly clarifies how to interpret the paper's principal comparison of data types.
